rules.safety_requirement: must ensure the computed pointer q = directory + 12*entry + 2 remains within the bounds of the exif buffer before dereferencing or reading from q
rules.note: Loop iterates entry < number_entries and computes q from directory; a later guard breaks if q > exif+length-12, but the pointer arithmetic itself may exceed the buffer before the guard is evaluated.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure q points to at least 2 readable bytes before calling ReadPropertyUnsignedShort(endian,q)
rules.note: ReadPropertyUnsignedShort reads from q; q is derived from directory and only a later splay-tree guard is linked, not a bounds check on q.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure q+4 points to at least 4 readable bytes before calling ReadPropertySignedLong(endian,q+4)
rules.note: ReadPropertySignedLong reads 4 bytes at q+4; no linked guard verifies that q+4 is within the exif buffer.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure the multiplication components*tag_bytes[format] does not overflow size_t before assigning to number_bytes
rules.note: components is a signed value read from the file and tag_bytes[format] is a size multiplier; the product is cast to size_t without a linked overflow guard.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure q+8 points to at least 4 readable bytes before calling ReadPropertySignedLong(endian,q+8)
rules.note: ReadPropertySignedLong reads 4 bytes at q+8; no linked guard verifies that q+8 is within the exif buffer.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure exif+dir_offset remains within the exif buffer before using p for subsequent reads
rules.note: p is computed from exif plus a signed dir_offset read from the file; no linked guard validates the resulting pointer against the buffer bounds.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure the result of AcquireQuantumMemory is checked for NULL before value is dereferenced or used
rules.note: AcquireQuantumMemory may return NULL; a linked guard checks value != NULL, but the allocation result must be validated before any use.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure p has at least number_bytes readable bytes before indexing p[i] in the loop
rules.note: Loop reads p[i] for i < number_bytes; p is derived from exif+dir_offset and no linked guard confirms p has number_bytes valid bytes.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure p1 points to at least 1 readable byte before dereferencing *(signed char *) p1
rules.note: EXIFMultipleValues dereferences p1 as a signed char; no linked guard verifies p1 is within the buffer.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure p1 points to at least sizeof(float) readable bytes before dereferencing *(float *) p1
rules.note: EXIFMultipleValues dereferences p1 as a float; no linked guard verifies p1 has sufficient readable bytes.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure p1 points to at least sizeof(double) readable bytes before dereferencing *(double *) p1
rules.note: EXIFMultipleValues dereferences p1 as a double; no linked guard verifies p1 has sufficient readable bytes.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure exif_resources is destroyed on all exit paths after it is allocated and populated
rules.note: DestroySplayTree is called at line 867 after a do-while loop; any early return or break before this point would leak exif_resources.
